reauth.title: Your session has ended.
reauth.text: Sign in again to carry on. This page and what you typed stay as they are, and what you pressed is sent once you are back.
reauth.hereInstead: Sign in on this page instead
reauth.noPopup: This browser cannot hand a sign-in back from another window, so sign in on this page.
reauth.finish: Finish signing in in the window that opened.
otherPerson.waiting: A different person signed in, so what was waiting on this page was not sent.
otherPerson.typed: A different person signed in, so what was typed on this page before was not put back.
restored: You are signed in again. What you had typed on this page was put back, and nothing was sent: press the button again to send it.
restored.unplaced: {n, plural, one {{n} value could not be put back, because the page no longer has a place for it.} other {{n} values could not be put back, because the page no longer has a place for them.}}
signedInAgain.text: The console carries on where you were. This window can be closed.
